# HY-Embodied source

- Upstream: [Tencent-Hunyuan/HY-Embodied](https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/HY-Embodied).
- Paper: [Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0: Efficient Physical-World Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.12894).
- Source: the Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0 source snapshot; its upstream commit is not recorded.
- License: [Apache-2.0](LICENSE), also retained in the [model subdirectory](Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0/LICENSE).

This directory preserves the upstream model source and documentation for serving HY-Embodied. No separate TARSphere patch is recorded for this component. Model weights are installed separately. Original copyright and dependency notices are retained.
